title: vatica lanceifolia
intro: Vatica lanceifolia, commonly known as the Lance-leaved Dipterocarp, is a species of tree in the family Dipterocarpaceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin diseases, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit antioxidant, antiviral, and antifungal activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the medicinal potential of Vatica lanceifolia and its bioactive constituents.
